name: Living entity
description: A mob or creature with model, stats, AI goals, sounds and natural spawning.

fields.label: Model
fields.help: Built-in: Biped, Chicken, Cod, Cow, Creeper, Ghast, Ocelot, Pig, Piglin, Salmon, Silverfish, Slime, Spider, Villager, Witch; or a Java model from this mod.

fields.label: Translucent model (procedure)
fields.help: When set, this procedure decides the value instead of the checkbox.

fields.label: Shaking (like zombie villager conversion) (procedure)
fields.help: When set, this procedure decides the value instead of the checkbox.

fields.label: Visual scale (procedure)
fields.help: When set, this procedure computes the value instead of the fixed number.

fields.label: Hitbox scale (procedure)
fields.help: When set, this procedure computes the value instead of the fixed number.

fields.label: Solid hitbox (others can stand on it)
Solid hitbox (others can stand on it) (procedure)
fields.help: When set, this procedure decides the value instead of the checkbox.

fields.label: Custom egg texture
fields.help: Optional; replaces the colored egg.

fields.label: Creative tabs
fields.help: Creative inventory tabs that list this element. Tabs defined in this mod are offered as well.

fields.label: Is a boss (shows a boss bar)
Name tag label
fields.help: Optional text always shown above the entity.

fields.label: Data entries
fields.help: Values stored on each entity and synced to clients; usable by procedures, layers and animations.

fields.label: Or entity data condition
fields.help: Name of a logic entity data entry; used instead of the procedure.

fields.label: Animations
fields.help: Only applies to Java models.

fields.label: Behavior type
fields.help: Mob is hostile-style, Creature is passive-style, Raider joins raids.

fields.label: Breathes underwater (procedure)
fields.help: When set, this procedure decides the value instead of the checkbox.

fields.label: Pushed by fluids (procedure)
fields.help: When set, this procedure decides the value instead of the checkbox.

fields.label: Bound GUI
fields.help: GUI element of this mod used as the entity inventory. Empty for none.

fields.label: Listening radius (procedure)
fields.help: When set, this procedure computes the value instead of the fixed number.

fields.label: Hurt
fields.help: Returning false cancels the damage; returning nothing keeps it.

fields.label: Base AI from
fields.help: Copies the AI of a vanilla mob instead of the goal blocks below.

fields.label: Can breed
fields.help: Breeding forces AI on and disables the base AI.

fields.label: Ranged projectile
fields.help: "Default item" shoots the item below; otherwise the name of a projectile element.

fields.label: AI goals
fields.help: Goal blocks (editor "aitasks"). Defaults to melee attack, wander, retaliate, look around and swim.
